channel.title: Square Foot Stories: Bedroom Decor Ideas
channel.description: Bedroom Decor Ideas from Square Foot Stories

item.title: Overnight Guests in a Studio Apartment: A Simple Checklist
item.description: Having someone stay over when you live in a studio or one-bedroom? This checklist covers where they sleep, where their things go and how to keep a little privacy for both of you. It works with a sofa, an air mattress or a daybed. Save it before your next visitor arrives.

item.title: Small Bedroom Makeover Checklist: 7 Steps for a Fresh Look
item.description: Planning a small bedroom makeover? Follow this 7-step checklist in order, from decluttering and layout to bedding and lighting, so every change makes the room feel bigger and calmer. Save it for your makeover weekend.

item.title: 7 Small Bedroom Storage Ideas When You Have No Room for a Dresser
item.description: No space for a dresser in your small bedroom? These 7 storage ideas fit clothes into the bed, the walls and the closet instead. Practical, renter-friendly and easy to set up. Save this for your next bedroom reset.
